subject.title: feat: expose publisher account feed URLs

question: Should the stable account-feed v1 contract ship only after durable revision and continuation semantics are implemented in the parent PR, with this PR narrowed to profile discoverability?
rationale: The branch currently combines a small UI child with a permanent public API contract whose bounded-snapshot semantics conflict with the written specification and collaborator review.

options.title: Correct parent, narrow child
options.body: Fix revision and continuation semantics in the parent PR, then rebase this PR to the profile link and its focused tests.

options.title: Redefine the v1 snapshot
options.body: Explicitly redesign the schema and specification so clients cannot interpret sequence or completion as durable guarantees.

options.title: Pause feed exposure
options.body: Defer both feed endpoints and the profile link until durable feed state is product-approved and implemented.

recommendation.title: Correct parent, narrow child
recommendation.body: Fix revision and continuation semantics in the parent PR, then rebase this PR to the profile link and its focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick reviewed the current head and supplied the concrete contract requirements that determine whether this API can safely ship.
